answer: Each agent stakes a bonded escrow tied to a hardware-attested enclave key, and cloning one enclave leaves a telltale echo in the attestation ledger, so mass-minted agents are refused at the gate rather than inflating consensus. Because a key must match a fingerprint as uniquely patterned as an opal, and standing past the probationary haven needs a rotating quorum of bonded peers to co-sign, a sybil campaign burns capital on every clone it loses.
